more.good_when: A maintainer who changes how invoice reaches the printer learns from the tests that run on every `uv run pytest` whether a laptop with no default printer, or a printer that turns the job away, still stops with the message the accounting member got in the trial (「既定のプリンターが見つからないため、印刷できませんでした。…」). Today that step is left out of coverage, and its only case, the `--host` one, checks just that some printer name came back.

The accounting member whose saved statement ends in an empty row (a bare `,,,,,,` line or a blank line, as a spreadsheet leaves after a row's cells are cleared) learns from the message that the row is empty and can come out. Today they are told five times to write a customer, a date, a quantity, a price and a tax rate into line 5, a row they never meant to bill.
